photo.caption: An "unexpurgated" edition of Lady Chatterley's Lover (1959)
photo.description: One of earliest "unexpurgated" (or "complete and unexpurgated"?) editions, published in 1959, of the then-controversial Lady Chatterley's Lover by D.H. Lawrence (1885–1930). The "complete and unexpurgated" edition would then be published in the UK one year later for the first time. Previously, the novel was first privately published to the author's subscribers in the UK, the US, and France in 1928. Then it was commercially released in abridged, heavily censored form in 1932 in the United Kingdom and the United States.

Note that this map only includes laws specifically criminalising apostasy.
